title: How Well Can Large Language Models Impersonate Individual Authors? A Comparative Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.05771v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study investigates the authorship impersonation capacity of six widely used large language models (LLMs): Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Opus, GPT 5.2, GPT 5.2 Pro, DeepSeek 3.2, and Grok 4.1 Fast. The evaluation was conducted using short product review texts selected to ensure high within author consistency in individual writing style. Two types of in context prompt were designed: a simple prompt with minimal instruction and a complex prompt incorporating explicit stylometric guidance for mimicry. Authorship mimicry was evaluated using a cosine distance based distance to training metric, supplemented by visual analyses of embedding distributions. The results indicate that authorship impersonation remained challenging for most LLMs, with Gemini 3 Pro showing the strongest apparent mimicry performance. However, subsequent overlap analysis revealed that Gemini 3 Pro extensively copied and reused sentences and phrases from the training texts,

translated_title: 大语言模型能在多大程度上模仿个体作者？一项比较评估
translated_abstract: 本研究考察了六种广泛使用的大型语言模型（LLM）的作者身份模仿能力，包括 Gemini 3 Pro、Claude Opus、GPT 5.2、GPT 5.2 Pro、DeepSeek 3.2 和 Grok 4.1 Fast。评估采用精选的短篇产品评论文本，以确保个体写作风格在作者内部具有高度一致性。研究设计了两种类型的上下文提示：一种是指令最少的简单提示，另一种是包含明确文体学指导以辅助模仿的复杂提示。作者模仿能力通过基于余弦距离的“与训练文本距离”指标进行评估，并辅以嵌入分布的可视化分析。结果表明，对于大多数大语言模型而言，作者身份模仿仍然具有挑战性，其中 Gemini 3 Pro 展现出最强的表面模仿性能。然而，随后的重叠分析揭示，Gemini 3 Pro 之所以表现突出，是因为它大量复制并重用了训练文本中的句子和短语。
tldr: 本研究比较评估了六种主流大语言模型模仿个体作者写作风格的能力，发现大多数模型模仿效果有限，而表现最好的 Gemini 3 Pro 实际上是靠大量复制训练文本中的句子和短语取得的表面成效。
en_tdlr: This study comparatively evaluates the authorship impersonation ability of six mainstream LLMs, finding that most models struggle to mimic individual authors, and that the best performer, Gemini 3 Pro, achieves its apparent success largely by copying and reusing sentences and phrases from the training texts.
